objective: Recover embedded EXIF thumbnails of previously failed legacy Wall JPEGs without whole-resolution decoding or paid transformations.
productionBaselineEvidence: Production read-only stats 814 done, 209 failed with originals intact; legacy worker disabled and its token expired. Latest main includes merged PR #450 and auth PR #451.
chosenApproach: Strict byte-bounded APP1/EXIF JPEG IFD1 parser, small jpeg-js validation and existing bounded original decoder fallback. No automatic requeue.
selectionRationale: A pre-existing small JPEG avoids resource-heavy high-resolution decode when available, preserving security and no provider charges.
alternativeApproaches: Supabase paid Storage transformations (rejected: billed per unique image, quota not checked)
Increase Edge whole-image decode limit beyond 128MB (rejected: CPU/memory failures and unbounded resource demand)
preserveBehaviors: Private signed access and service-role-only worker retained
Worker remains disabled pending controlled production pilot
No other Wall or ad/video behavior touched
acceptanceChecks: No paid transforms, no unconditional repeat failures
SQL auth contract and focused tests pass
No production worker restart before gates
